name: REAPER
hint: a REAPER action ID (40757) or a custom action ID that starts with an underscore (_RS1234abcd). Needs an OSC control surface set up in REAPER's preferences

rules.source: REAPER's own Default.ReaperOSC describes /action/<id> and /action/_<command id> as quoted by search results and community write-ups; the file itself was not opened, and reaper.fm's OSC page only points to it
